fusions.name: Marrow Cracked
fusions.desc: A cracking weapon strike that deals 24 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Tipped Cauldron
fusions.desc: Tips a boiling cauldron across a wide cone 3 tiles long, dealing 11 fire damage to everything in it and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: The Common Pot
fusions.desc: Sets a cookpot down where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Well-Fed Bulwark
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
